sloka: हिताश्च शूराश्च समाहिताश्च कुलेषु जाताश्च महागुणेषु ।मनस्विनः शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठाः कोट्यग्रतस्ते सुभृताश्च योधाः ।। ५.५२.२४।।।।
transliteration: hitāśca śūrāśca samāhitāśca kuleṣu jātāśca mahāguṇeṣu ।manasvinaḥ śastrabhṛtāṁ variṣṭhāḥ koṭyagrataste subhṛtāśca yodhāḥ ।। 5.52.24।।।।

translations.english: "O delighter of demons even the gods and demons who are endowed with valour and energy cannot win you. You are invincible. It is not proper for you to lose chances of a good war.
